# Release Notes

## Shipped

- v2 Hello: shipped.

## Planned v2 Work

The planned v2 work focuses on expanding the wire protocol beyond its current single-message surface: the `Msg` enum will grow from just `Ping` to include response and error variants (such as `Pong` and `Error`), while `decode` will be tightened from its permissive substring match to strict, exact-token parsing with proper error reporting so that malformed input fails cleanly instead of being partially accepted. Alongside this, encode/decode round-trip properties will be locked in with tests, and explicit protocol versioning will be introduced so v1 and v2 peers can negotiate compatibility during rollout.
